title: Issuance roundtable
description: Ethereum's issuance is one of the ecosystem's most contested open questions. This session will host remated talks and notably highlight the contentious topics that emerged from the recent EIP-8363 discussion. The aim of the roundtable is to brings together those arguing for and against the change towards a clearer view of the trade-offs. Discussion will be open in the room and individuals willing to present something are kindly invited to reach out to Jerome de Tychey for scheduling.
